Hi, I just emailed you about my GekkoScience KBox (serial ····). It powers on and connects to the pool, but it doesn't hash: it only draws 13 W in every power mode. The web UI shows "Error talking to the unit", with voltage, temp and power all N/A. I already tried a factory reset, Ethernet and WiFi, a cold start and a different pool. Could you help with a warranty repair or replacement?

Sorry, Patrick. You've done the right troubleshooting already, so that reads like a dead hashboard, not a setup issue. That goes through RMA: fill the intake form and you'll get a prepaid return label. Processing takes up to 10 days after the unit reaches the warehouse.

One thing I have to ask: was it ever overclocked or modified? Overclocked units aren't covered.
No, never overclocked or modified. It only ran on the stock Low / Medium / High power modes from the KBox's own interface, on standard firmware. The case has never been opened.

Good, then you're covered. Go ahead with the RMA form above, put the serial ···· and order Shop···· on it, and mention the 13 W / "Error talking to the unit" symptom so the warehouse knows what to test.

That's the same fault, confirmed: the web UI can't talk to the hashboard controller, so nothing it tries to apply sticks. Pool settings aren't the problem here, your pool URL is fine.

Good screenshot for the file. Attach it to your RMA if the form still lets you, otherwise JD can add it. He'll have it from 10am ET tomorrow, or tonight on Discord, @nullhashrate.
error talking to board

Yes, exactly that. The controller boots and gets on the network, but it can't reach the hashboard, which is why voltage, temp and power all read N/A and it sits at 13 W. That's the controller running on its own with the board dead.

Nothing left to try at your end. The R. you filed is the right path.
fans spinning

Normal, and it fits. The fans run off the controller, not the hashboard, so they spin at default speed even when the board never comes up. Same for the lights and the web page. 13 W is about what the controller and fans alone pull.

So spinning fans don't mean it's working. Your RMA stands.
no hashing

Right, and it won't hash until the board is fixed or the unit is replaced. A KBOX at 22 TH/s pulls around 330 W; yours is at 13 W, so no chips are running at all.

You've done everything there is to do. Power it down and leave it off until the label arrives, no point running it.
